content: ज्ञापक {%a.%} [ज्ञा-णिच् ल्यु] Making known, teaching, informing, indicating <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-कः@} .²1 A teacher. .²2 A commander, a master. .²3 A master of requests, an officer of the court of an Indian prince; <ls>Pt. 3</ls>. .{@-कम्@} (In <ab>phil.</ab>) A significant expression, a suggestive rule or precept, said of such rules as imply something more than what is actually expressed by the words of those rules themselves.
